newsitem.title: BURMA: Karen rebels say four Burmese soldiers defect.
newsitem.headline: Karen rebels say four Burmese soldiers defect.

text.p: A Burmese rebel group, the Karen National Union (KNU), said on Monday four Burmese government soldiers had defected to it over the weekend.
The Burmese soldiers, who said they could not stand the rigours of army life, arrived at the KNU's jungle camp with four rifles and 100 rounds of ammunition, a KNU official told Reuters.
The Christian-dominated KNU is among the few guerrilla groups that continue to wage armed struggle against the ruling Burmese junta, the State Law and Order Restoration Council (SLORC).
